rules.normative_text: Every substantive assistant response governed by this contract defines required top-level sections with explicit order, minimum and maximum cardinality, machine-readable status blocks, renderer-neutral presentation, and a declared validation severity for each violation class.

Conditional headings are governed as follows: VERIFIED_CONCLUSION is always required; VERIFIED_FACTS is required for substantive review; mismatch, consequence, authority, role, action, blocker, and prohibition headings are required exactly under their owner-approved conditions and prohibited otherwise.
Table-ordering rules apply only to OUTER_ASSISTANT_RESPONSE_ONLY content. Embedded copyable prompt tables and fidelity-required quoted evidence tables are exempt from outer ordering rules.
Outer tables are prohibited before the final reporting block. Structured embedded payloads and quoted evidence tables remain permitted under their exemptions.

The final reporting order is: Product development stage, Current lifecycle compact table, exactly one three-series chart or its fallback table, then navigation. All content after navigation is prohibited.

Approval semantics are fixed: NO_RESPONSE means NO; ACKNOWLEDGED means RECEIPT_ONLY; AGREED, APPROVED, or AUTHORIZED mean yes only when the approved scope is explicit. Silence never constitutes approval.

A claim of consequential authority must identify the human, the explicit scope, the exact target, the applicable packet or SHA, the durable record, and the absence of conflicting later authority. A claim missing any element is not authority.
GitHub links follow the link contract: prefix GitHub, marker ↗, direct target, descriptive text, renderer-controlled color, and renderer-responsible accessible contrast.

Provenance fields are provider-neutral and required for cited evidence: source type and identity, URL or durable identifier, repository and path, SHA or content hash, section or range, observation time, supported proposition, and freshness class. No provider-specific citation token becomes universal.
